Container.Name: sinopec-agent
Container.Overview: Sinopec Fuel Card Invoice Automation & AI Research Server (Rust + SQLite + MCP + Steel CDP)

Config.Name: REST and MCP Port
Config.Description: HTTP REST (/api/v1), MCP (/mcp), and Human Action UI (/human/{token})

Config.Name: Appdata Directory
Config.Description: SQLite sinopec.db, secrets, auth cookies, downloads, and redacted research data

Config.Name: SINOPEC_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public URL used in Human Action links

Config.Name: STEEL_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Existing Unraid Steel Browser API URL

Config.Name: STEEL_CDP_URL
Config.Description: Existing Unraid Steel Browser CDP WebSocket URL

Config.Name: SINOPEC_RESEARCH_MODE
Config.Description: Enable Research Mode & Research MCP tools

Config.Name: SINOPEC_ALLOW_AUTO_SUBMIT
Config.Description: Allow automatic invoice submission without manual confirmation
